svg.text: One dot: row enable, direction and fire
A dot flips when current runs through its coil. The direction of the current decides the colour; it only flows while both drivers of the path are on.
Row address and pin 11 (ROW-LOW) high, then a pulse on pin 19
Pins 10/11 enable the row side, the pulse on pin 19 the column side.
Row address and pin 10 (ROW-HIGH) high, then a pulse on pin 19
Pins 10/11 enable the row side, the pulse on pin 19 the column side.
Never ROW-HIGH and ROW-LOW together, and never a long high on pin 19: a coil that stays energised overheats.
